name: qkd_ctrl_pc_host_static_c1

pin_regs.reason: Parent is wires only; the three hardened children own every registered endpoint (all seams flop-driven, native audit PASS on each child) and their own clock entries. Parent wires remain part of the die hop budget.

slot_change_request: KVCTRL wires-parent cluster 207.36x233.28 replaces the 129.6x216 e2 tile inside the 247.512x378 controller slot; +2 clock entry ports (pll_hbm_port, pll_hbm_ecc), data ports unchanged; signals M2-M6, PG M7 over M5-capped children.

job.purpose: KVCTRL split, lead decision 2026-10-16 option A: the controller is replicated per PC, so the wires-only parent qkd_ctrl_pc_host_static is hardened ONCE as a cluster of three closed native-PASS children (core W 108.0x216 (core_s4), port 69.12x79.92 at the top of the E column, ECC 41.04x43.2 mirrored (MX) directly below it so port kv_d (S face) meets ECC i_code across a 10.8 um gap) inside the 247.512x378 controller slot. Clock entries: one top port per hard-child clock pin (ck, pll_hbm -> core; pll_hbm_port -> port; pll_hbm_ecc -> ECC; all three HBM entries carry the same 1024 ps clock, the die delivers phi - R_i each). Parent = wires only (no flops, no tree). Entries are timed in the default related core domain (833.333 ps), a conservative over-constraint of the 1024 ps hclk seams (no relaxation).
